walkthroughs.body_html:
Carl Linnaeus (1758) ranked life into nested groups:

Domain → Kingdom → Phylum → Class → Order → Family → Genus → Species

Binomial: Panthera leo. Mnemonic: 'Dear King Philip Came Over For Good Soup'.

Cladistics groups organisms by shared derived characters (synapomorphies), not overall similarity.

A clade = common ancestor + all descendants. Birds belong to clade Reptilia (sharing scales, amniotic egg with crocs).

Molecular phylogenetics uses sequence differences as a molecular clock.

Carl Woese (1977) used 16S rRNA to discover Archaea are distinct from Bacteria. Result: three domains replaced two empires.

- Bacteria — peptidoglycan walls.
- Archaea — extremophiles, ether-linked lipids.
- Eukarya — true nuclei.

This is a major paradigm shift — nature of science: molecular data overturned morphology-based classification.
